Victreebel.description: Doubles its Speed stat whenever the weather is harsh sunlight.

Vileplume.description: Gives opposing Pokémon a chance to be poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep whenever they make contact with it.

Vivillon.description: Raises the accuracy of all of its moves by 30%.

Volcarona.description: Gives opposing Pokémon a chance to be burned whenever they make contact with it.

Watchog.description: Boosts the power of its move by 30% whenever it ends up moving last in the turn.

Weavile.description: Makes any move an opponent uses against it cost twice the normal amount of PP.

Whimsicott.description: Gives all of its status moves increased priority so they go first in the turn.

Wyrdeer.description: Makes it immune to Grass-type moves and instead raises its own Attack stat by one stage when hit by one.

Zoroark.description: Lets it enter battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its party until it's hit by a move or the disguise is otherwise broken.
